transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Yeah, um… I’ve been having trouble at work. I keep making these careless mistakes on sales reports—copying the wrong numbers from the dashboard, or missing a line in a procedure I’m supposed to check. I think I’ve gone over it, but then something still gets missed.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or staying focused on tasks lately?

Yeah… I guess so. If I’m going through call notes or checking numbers, it doesn’t take much—like somebody talking across the room, or even just some thought about home—and I’m off track before I realize it.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
Not really, no. I mean, I get frustrated, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling sad or stopped liking things.
Have you noticed yourself getting more irritable or easily annoyed lately, even if you’re not feeling down or sad?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get annoyed sometimes, but not more than usual, I guess.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual or noticed a lack of energy, even if you haven’t been doing anything particularly strenuous?
Not really. I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I haven’t noticed some big lack of energy or anything.
Have you been feeling restless or noticed yourself moving around more than usual, like an inner need to be constantly doing something?
Yeah… sometimes. Like in long meetings, I feel kind of buzzy inside. I’ll shift around a lot, tap my foot, or try to find a reason to get up.
How long have you been experiencing these issues with concentration and restlessness? Have they been present since childhood or have they developed more recently?

I think it’s been there since I was a kid, honestly. My mom still brings up notes from elementary school—teachers saying I rushed through work, lost homework, talked out of turn, couldn’t stay seated unless they kept reminding me. So… not really new.
